comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Response settings per request
themes.text: A program can change the `[http]` settings for the request it is handling. Its security headers, its CORS headers and its cookie defaults then follow the new values. A request that changes nothing costs nothing extra.
